model: sm92 (the show-time retrain of the release): the head reads its frozen trunk; queries use show-time intervals (the package's INTEGRATION.md section 6.10)
head: logits = out(relu(hidden(inputs))); inputs = 474 float32 values at the query (instant) row

layout: layer_norm(x0) (64): the residual after the input encoder (features2card, after its SiLU)
layer_norm(x4) (64): after layer round 3 (step (1,3)) = the final residual before prehead_norm
head_p (128): relu(head_p.0(prehead_norm(x4))), the instant head's hidden layer
frozen.layer_norm: no affine parameters, eps 1e-5, biased variance (torch.nn.functional.layer_norm)

explicit.source: the user's reviews before the query (card id, grade 1-4, duration ms) and the query's own card id and elapsed days; reference: reference/answer_time_numpy.py explicit_features (= scripts/sm82c_head.py explicit_features)
explicit.ln_time: ln(max(duration_ms, 1) / 1000) in float64; only durations > 0 are recorded
explicit.centre: ln times are centred on ln 8 s
explicit.median: exact running median (two heaps; even count = mean of the two middle values) per grade 1-4 of recorded times, fallback the median over all grades, then ln 8 s

output.layout: logits [4 grades (Again, Hard, Good, Easy) x 16 bins], softmax per grade
output.bins_meaning: bin 0 < 500 ms, bin k = [edge k-1, edge k), bin 15 >= 60 s (the time cap)
output.median: ln seconds, linear in ln time inside the crossing bin (bin 0 from ln 0.25 s, bin 15 = 60 s); reference median_log_s
output.fast: P(answer under 3.891 s | grade) = sum of bins 0..6

valid: query (instant) rows of reviews on a later day than the card's previous review (elapsed days >= 1); first reviews and same-day reviews are not predicted (their interval input holds their own answer time in training)
